expected.outcome: State payouts run weekly on Fridays with a 2 business-day processing time
expected.reason: Platform merchant policy

opening_message: how often do i get paid out

expected.outcome: State weekly Friday payouts, processed over 2 business days
expected.reason: Platform merchant policy

expected.reason: Platform merchant policy

expected.reason: Platform merchant policy

expected.reason: Platform merchant policy

expected.reason: Platform merchant policy

opening_message: how long until payout funds clear

expected.outcome: State a 2 business-day processing time after the Friday payout run
expected.reason: Platform merchant policy

opening_message: can i opt out of restocking fees

expected.outcome: Explain restocking fees are opt-in per store
expected.reason: Platform merchant policy

opening_message: what day are payouts sent

expected.outcome: State payouts are sent weekly on Fridays
expected.reason: Platform merchant policy

opening_message: is the restocking fee on all items

expected.outcome: Explain it applies to opened items only, up to 15%
expected.reason: Platform merchant policy

opening_message: do i get paid daily or weekly

expected.outcome: State payouts are weekly, not daily, on Fridays
expected.reason: Platform merchant policy
